titles.romaji: Shingeki no Kyojin: Chimi Kyara Gekijou - Rivai-han Part 2
titles.native: ｢進撃の巨人｣ちみキャラ劇場”新生リヴァイ班” Part 2

description: Shingeki no Kyojin Season 3 Part 2 DVD/BD specials. They are chibi parody shorts; one video was included on each of the DVD/BDs for a total of three. Each video contained three stories, which continued the chibi parody story from the previous chibi parody specials included on the DVD/BDs of the previous seasons.
